prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s, Yemaya, the Yoruba ocean mother goddess, latina curves physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, a sculpted high braided updo in natural black — full body carved deep red coral and iridescent mother-of-pearl fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid coral and shell curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted coral sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep red branching coral relief across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID iridescent pearl-white nacre sections shimmering pink and gold between the coral, with thin brass inlay lines running along the grain of every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: back to the camera, shoulder blades emphasized, face turned in profile — most extreme latina curves silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of the same coral and mother-of-pearl, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, made of the same coral and mother-of-pearl with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT coral — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque matte deep wine-burgundy lips with a precise edge, soft bronze smoky eyeshadow, defined lashes.

Background: a vast bright exhibition hall with a smooth pale floor, steel roof trusses, standard-height doors and plain white partition walls, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
